descriptive_qas.question: What is the blue ball on the floor doing during this segment, and how is it moving relative to the white central platform with the yellow ball on top?
choices: A) rolling back toward the camera and away from the central white platform, growing larger in view
B) bouncing upward off the floor into the side of the central white platform that has another ball resting on top of it
C) rolling steadily along the floor away from the camera, toward the central white platform that has another ball resting on top of it
D) remaining nearly stationary on the floor beside the central white platform that has another ball resting on top of it

descriptive_qas.question: What happens when the blue floor ball reaches the white platform in the middle of the scene?
choices: A) the floor ball misses the platform entirely and the platform stays untouched while the ball rolls past
B) the floor ball stops against one of the platform's legs and stays there while the platform stays standing
C) the floor ball rolls underneath the platform between its legs, clipping them on the way through, and the platform stays standing without tipping over
D) the floor ball slams into the platform and knocks it over onto one side

descriptive_qas.question: In this strike segment, does the blue floor ball hit the nearby left-side domino row directly, or does the platform get knocked over into it first?
choices: A) the floor ball collides directly with a domino in the row, without first knocking the platform over into it
B) the floor ball rolls past the nearby row and strikes a different domino row farther to the right
C) the yellow ball leaves the platform and is the object that collides with the domino in the row
D) the floor ball first knocks the platform over, and the falling platform then hits the domino row

descriptive_qas.question: What are the black dominoes beside the platform doing in this segment, and how do they fall along the row?
choices: A) the closest domino is knocked over and falls into its neighbor, which then tips the next one, propagating a chain reaction along the row
B) the closest domino falls away from the row and misses its neighbor, so the sequence stops after the first tile
C) the far end domino is struck first and the row topples back toward the platform in the opposite direction
D) the nearest domino stays upright while the blue ball rolls past it, leaving the rest of the row standing still

causal_qas.question: Why does the white platform stay upright when the blue floor ball brushes past it from below and to the left during this segment?
choices: A) the yellow ball rolls across the tabletop and counterweights the blue ball's impact, so the platform never begins to tip
B) the ball hits the platform head-on from underneath — the strong upward shove lifts one side and then drops it back into a more stable position
C) the contact is a glancing one — the ball brushes the platform without delivering enough horizontal force to remove a leg's support, so the platform stays balanced
D) the blue ball misses the platform entirely — it passes by the left side without touching either leg or the underside, so nothing disturbs it

causal_qas.question: Why does the first domino in the upper middle-left row begin to fall during this segment?
choices: A) the support under the platform shifted and sent a loose piece across the floor into the domino row
B) the yellow ball rolled off the table and clipped the first domino in the row, knocking it sideways
C) the rolling floor ball reached the row and struck a domino directly, transferring its momentum into that standing piece
D) the first domino started tipping because a neighboring domino from the left row slid into it first

causal_qas.question: Why are the black dominoes near the blue ball continuing to fall one after another in this segment?
choices: A) a separate upright stack on the right has toppled left into this row, so the chain reaction is being driven from the far side
B) the rolling floor ball had earlier struck the first domino directly, and that fall is now tipping each successive piece along the row
C) the blue ball is rolling into each domino in turn, knocking them down directly instead of a prior strike starting the chain
D) the yellow ball on the raised platform has just dropped off and hit the middle of the row, causing the dominoes to fall outward
